newsitem.title: POLAND: EBRD DENIES MULLING INVESTMENT IN POLISH FOOD FIRM.
newsitem.headline: EBRD DENIES MULLING INVESTMENT IN POLISH FOOD FIRM.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) denied a Friday newspaper report that it planned to invest up to $40 million in Polish food processor and trader Hortex.
"We are not working for Hortex, the story is not based on facts," EBRD's press office in London said.
Rzeczpospolita newspaper said, quoting unnamed sources, Hortex was negotiating with EBRD a possible investment in the company worth $30-40 million.
Officials from Hortex, whose activities are based on fruit and vegetable processing, were not immediately available for comment.
The Rzeczpospolita article also said Hortex's board was mulling a bond issue, which would be likely issued by Bank Gospodarki Zywnosciowej (BGZ), which has a 42 percent stake in the food processor.
